action.content: Can you write a poem about the pros and cons of playing a lot of video games? Please make sure it's at least 40 sentences long (don't forget to add punctuations). You must highlight some words or phrases in your response, like *highlighted phrase*.
action.label: context

action.content:
The screen glows bright in the quiet room.
*Digital worlds* await your command.
You can travel to lands far away.
*Fantasy realms* are just a click away.
Heroes rise from the pixelated dust.
*Epic battles* test your skill and trust.
Friends gather online to fight as one.
*Global connections* are easily spun.
Puzzles challenge the mind to think.
*Strategic plans* make the victory link.
Stress melts away in the game's embrace.
*A safe escape* from a chaotic place.
Reflexes sharpen with every match.
*Quick decisions* become a natural act.
Learning languages through foreign quests.
*New cultures* are put to the tests.
But the clock ticks on without a sound.
*Lost hours* are never to be found.
The sun sets while you stay inside.
*Real life* begins to fade and hide.
Eyes grow tired from the glowing light.
*Physical health* suffers in the night.
Shoulders ache from the hunched-up pose.
*Back pain* becomes a heavy load.
Social skills may start to rust.
*Face-to-face* talks feel like a must.
Sleep is stolen by the final boss.
*Restless nights* cause a mental loss.
Money spent on skins and loot boxes.
*Financial strain* creates some boxes.
Anger flares when the connection drops.
*Frustration* fills the empty stops.
Reality seems dull compared to play.
*The real world* feels like a gray day.
Addiction grows like a silent weed.
*Compulsive habits* plant a deep seed.
Schoolwork slips as the game takes hold.
*Academic grades* begin to fold.
Family time gets pushed to the side.
*Broken bonds* are hard to hide.
Yet the joy of winning is so sweet.
*Triumph* makes the struggle complete.
The balance is a tricky line to walk.
*Moderation* is the key to talk.
Too much play brings a heavy cost.
*Too little* leaves the spirit lost.
Find the middle ground with care.
*Healthy habits* are what we share.
Enjoy the fun but know when to stop.
*Life outside* is worth a drop.
The game is great but not the all.
*True happiness* stands tall and small.
So play your part with wisdom deep.
*Balance* is the promise we keep.
